fieldNotes.resolution: Roster gave only city-level coords (downtown York, wrong site). Resolved to UNFI York DC, 225 Cross Farm Lane, York PA 17406, Greenspring Industrial Park - a 675,000 sq ft legacy-UNFI DC opened 2008. Confirmed via warehouse.ninja, LoopNet/JLL listing, TruckMap and the 2008 UNFI IR press release.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding/swing gate at the public road (Cross Farm Lane) or on the internal access driveway. Street View 2012/2023 shows an open-campus driveway with a turnaround near the office; trucks reach the dock yard via a wide internal driveway with no checkpoint structure. Open-campus archetype.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth identified at the property entrance, the office turnaround, or the truck-yard mouth. The internal driveway opens directly onto the dock apron. Listed uncertain - a booth could exist inside the truck yard out of clear view, but none is visible in z19-z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access driveway from Cross Farm Lane wraps the building to the truck-yard side - easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved dock aprons and a large trailer drop yard north of the building provide ample internal queuing room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The internal truck driveway and dock apron are very wide with unused paved width - room to stripe an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot at the north end of the building, full of parked trailers in marked rows (`dropArea` well over 50).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~110 dock doors total across the north, east and west building faces from the continuous rhythm of bays and backed-in trailers. High count appropriate for a 675k sq ft DC; exact number uncertain from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks wrap continuously around the north, east and west faces as one operational complex - not two physically separate ship/rcv banks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Wide truck driveway; lane count estimated at ~2 in / 2 out, uncertain from imagery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Greenspring Industrial Park is set among farmland and woods NE of York city, with a residential subdivision to the SE - edge-of-town / rural setting.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Within an industrial park near York metro, not isolated - cellular coverage adequate.
